prompt: Photograph a figure in a worn green leather armchair in a cluttered study, taken on a Leica with a 50mm lens from a low angle, framed off-centre with the out-of-focus rim of a brandy glass in the near foreground. He is lifting a china cup of tea towards his face, which has no mouth to drink from. His whole head is in a cream knitted balaclava with no eye or mouth holes; a thin black ring is stitched around the face, and high inside it, over one eye, a small red silk triangle with rounded corners. A black velvet smoking jacket, a black roll-neck, black silk gloves. Beside him a small old television on a stack of books flickers with a news picture. One brass table lamp camera-left with a fringed shade lights him warm from the side; the rest of the room sinks into brown dark. Kodak Gold 200, soft grain. Thanks.
